reviews.title: Not Worth $9.99 a Week for a pre-installed app
reviews.text:
The app is free to download, but the only feature that is actually free to use is English-to-Spanish translation. Every other tool requires a subscription. The listing gives the impression that there are multiple free features available, but that was not my experience.

After reading other reviews, it appears many users have raised the same concern and continue to receive the same generic response instead of any meaningful changes or clarification. This doesn't appear to be an issue that's being addressed.

Charging $9.99 per week for AI chat is also difficult to justify when similar AI services, including free versions of ChatGPT available online, can be used without paying. If the only usable feature without a subscription is English-to-Spanish translation, that should be made clear before users download the app so people know exactly what they're getting

reviews.title: When did a dictionary become a luxury item?
reviews.text:
I understand paying for AI-powered features, advanced writing assistance, or other genuinely innovative tools. Those add value.
But charging $10 per week just to access definitions and synonyms feels excessive. These are some of the most basic language-learning functions imaginable. At this point, a physical dictionary is probably a better deal.
I’m not against subscriptions. I’m against turning fundamental reference tools into premium features. If the app wants to monetize advanced capabilities, that’s completely reasonable. But putting basic dictionary and thesaurus functions behind such an expensive paywall makes the pricing model feel disconnected from user expectations.

reviews.title: Beware they are uploading all your texts
reviews.text: On my iPhone after I download this app I got a weird warning when using imessage. It said I had to go into settings and allow the app permission to upload all my text messages so that they could improve the app. That includes everything in your imessage app such as phone numbers, personal info, passwords anything in a text on your phone. Further if you allow imessage to access photos or any other app they can also upload data from those apps.  You can disable full access but that is the default setting when you install it. I deleted the app immediately

reviews.title: Can’t hear
reviews.text:
I went to Puerto Vallarta and I had no luck with this app. I mean, I could speak into it and then it’ll translate in Spanish and the other way around, but if I’m at a table or close by to somebody, it can’t hear anybody it’s like I’m listening. It was complete waste of my time if I turn on Google though Google did really well I’m like and that’s for free app so I don’t know. in fact, if I’m texting on my regular Apple iPhone, it can hear a conversation like across the room and it starts texting what somebody else is saying across the room that’s how well texting is why can’t this app  hear unless I’m 6 inches from the microphone. That’s the only it hears anything I’m saying or the other person like 5 feet from me I don’t get it . I thought this would be a better app cause I’m paying 9.99 a week but obviously it wasn’t. I was very unhappy with it.

Here’s the kicker I have the Apple pod three for translation, but I didn’t feel like putting them in my ears. People thinking I’m listening to music and ignoring them. I don’t even know why I bought them but they work well on a plane when I’m watching my movies lol

reviews.title: This is a scam, beware
reviews.text: This app promised a 1 week special offer. I paid £0.49 for the first week. It took the money. I loaded up the app and it asked for another £0.49 which I paid again. I then loaded up the app and it wanted to charge me £31.99 - this is absolutely outrageous - this company is a scam tool

reviews.title: charged me without me knowing
reviews.text: The app itself does what it should and translates. I used it only twice, but was all of a sudden charged £8? I was completely unaware that this was happening, and am very unhappy. Do not use this unless you want to pay for it

reviews.title: This app will ruin your phone.
reviews.text: I installed this app to give it a try and was hopeful it would be productive. I installed the translation keyboard and quickly found it was buggy and didn’t work very well, so I uninstalled it. But now I’m stuck with leftover artifacts that make my iPhone keyboard not work correctly. I’ve tried every tip to uninstall it. It’s still interferes with my keyboard, even after deleting the app!!! I think my only choice is going to be a factory reset my entire phone, which is a massive pain in the neck. Avoid this app! Apparently this is a known problem as I was able to find some other posts about it online, and yet the developers still haven’t fixed it. It’s infuriating.
